title: Delayed Count of Equal Elements
description:
You are given an integer array `nums` of length `n` and an integer `k`.

For each index `i`, define the **delayed count** as the number of indices `j` such that:

	* `i + k < j <= n - 1`, and

	* `nums[j] == nums[i]`

Return an array `ans` where `ans[i]` is the **delayed count** of index `i`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Delayed Count of Equal Elements.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
